tooltips.sumofficeDiscoveryUrl: The WOPI discovery address of your SumOffice stack, as the EspoCRM server reaches it, e.g. https://office.example.com/hosting/discovery. Press Check connection after saving.
tooltips.sumofficeVerifyProof: Every call from the editors is checked against the proof key published in discovery. Keep it on in production.
tooltips.sumofficeCaBundle: Path to a CA bundle on the EspoCRM server, only when the SumOffice stack uses a certificate from a private CA. Leave empty for a public certificate.
